description:
Invoke function getAllEnterpriseInteractions

TIP: Gets ALL Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions tenant-wide — every user prompt to Copilot and Copilot's response, across Teams, Word, Outlook, M365 Chat, etc. Returns aiInteraction objects with userId, sessionId, appClass (e.g. IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.Teams, IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.BizChat), interactionDateTime, body (the actual prompt/response content), conversationType. Supports $filter (e.g. appClass eq '...'), $top (recommended 100 for performance), date ranges. SENSITIVE: this returns the actual prompt content tenant-wide — gates a high surveillance capability. Use ONLY with documented investigative purpose (security incident, legal hold, compliance audit) and log each query in the internal investigation journal per PIPEDA / Loi 25 / RGPD legitimacy requirements. Licensed users only (Microsoft 365 Copilot with Graph-grounded chat service plan).

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: get-all-copilot-interactions
